title: Kissed Slovakian Chicken Braised
description: A tangy and chewy brunch dish featuring chicken stock cube, poach, and low-sodium-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with caraway seeds, paprika, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a separate plate and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the onion to the skillet, cooking until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth and red wine vinegar to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cover with a lid.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Strain the braising liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding any solids.
Skim off any excess fat from the surface of the braising liquid.
Simmer the braising liquid over medium heat until reduced to about half its original volume, stirring occasionally.
Serve the sliced chicken with the reduced braising liquid spooned over the top.
